'''''Galium glaucum''''' or '''waxy bedstraw''' is a plant species of the [[Rubiaceae]]. It is native to central Europe from [[Portugal]] to [[Ukraine]], and sparingly naturalized in a few locations in [[North America]] ([[Quebec]], [[Ontario]], [[Connecticut]] and [[New Jersey]]).<ref name="ruthpickles">[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=86410 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families ''Galium glaucum'']</ref><ref>[http://bonap.net/MapGallery/County/Galium%20glaucum.png Biota of North America Program ''Galium glaucum'']</ref><ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=galium+glaucum Altervista Flora Italiana ''Galium glaucum'']</ref>

==Subspecies==
Three subspecies are recognized:<ref name="ruthpickles"/>

*''Galium glaucum ''subsp''. australe'' <small>Franco</small> - [[Spain]] and [[Portugal]]
*''Galium glaucum ''subsp''. glaucum'' - [[France]] to [[Ukraine]]
*''Galium glaucum ''subsp''. murcicum'' <small>(Boiss. & Reut.) O.Bolòs & Vigo</small> - southeastern [[Spain]]
